title: Robotaxi operators will face fines for blocking first responders | TechCrunch
summary: Autonomous vehicle (AV) technology companies like Tesla, Waymo, and Zoox will have to provide first responders with local, on-the-ground support when their robotaxis cause problems under a new California law.
